Questions 21–25

--30 Questions 21--25 Complete the summary below Write ONE WORD ONLY for each answer.

The School of Education Libraries

The School of Education Libraries The libraries on both sites provide internet access and have a variety of materials on education. The Castle Road library has books on sociology, together with and other resources relevant to the majority of school subjects. The Fordham library includes resources for teaching in education and special needs. Current issues of periodicals are available at both libraries, although issues are only available at Fordham.

Which THREE topics do this term’s study skills workshops cover?

transcript.en: Good afternoon.
transcript.zh: 下午好。

transcript.en: Can I help you?
transcript.zh: 有什么能帮你的吗？

transcript.en: Good afternoon.
transcript.zh: 下午好。

transcript.en: Yes, I've just transferred to the School of Education, and I'd like information about joining the library.
transcript.zh: 下午好。是的，我刚转到教育学院，我想知道如何加入图书馆。

transcript.en: Well, the School of Education has libraries on two sites, as I'm sure you know.
transcript.zh: 我想你肯定知道，教育学院有两个图书馆。

transcript.en: This one here is the Fordham Site, and the other is on Castle Road.
transcript.zh: 这个在福德姆，另一个在卫城路。

transcript.en: And is there any difference between the two libraries?
transcript.zh: 两个图书馆有什么不同吗？

transcript.en: Not in terms of their facilities.
transcript.zh: 设施上没有区别。

transcript.en: Access to online databases and the Internet is available at both sites and each site has a range of reference materials on education.
transcript.zh: 都可以进人在线数据库和网络，并且都有很多教育类参考资料。

transcript.en: Oh yes.
transcript.zh: 是的。

transcript.en: I see.
transcript.zh: 我明白了。

transcript.en: But the Castle Road site has books on the sociology of education and a collection of textbooks and teaching resources covering most of the subjects taught in secondary schools.
transcript.zh: 但是卫城路的图书馆有教育社会学的书和一些包括中学多数学科教学的教科书和教学资源。

transcript.en: Ah, right, but I'm training to be a primary teacher so I need to look at materials for the five to eleven age group.
transcript.zh: 好的，但是我要当小学老师，所以我需要查看5至11岁年龄组的资料。

transcript.en: Then you've come to the right place.
transcript.zh: 那你就来对地方了。

transcript.en: At Fordham we hold material relating to primary education, as well as special needs, but of course you'll need to familiarize yourself with both sites to make the most of our resources.
transcript.zh: 在福德姆，我们有小学教育和特殊教育相关的资料，但是你得先熟悉一下两边的图书馆以便充分利用。

transcript.en: You haven't mentioned periodicals.
transcript.zh: 你还没说期刊呢。

transcript.en: Are they held at both sites?
transcript.zh: 他们在两个地方都有预订吗？

transcript.en: Current issues, yes,  but if you want to look at back issues you'll need to use the CD-ROM databases which are held here at Fordham.
transcript.zh: 现刊都有，但是如果您想查看之前的期刊，需要使用福特汉姆的 CD-ROM 数据库。

transcript.en: I see.
transcript.zh: 明白了。

transcript.en: Now, about borrowing books, I'm living out of town, so I'm hoping I can borrow quite a few items, and cut down on the number of trips I have to make.
transcript.zh: 关于借书的事，我住在城外，所以我希望我能多借几本，免去几次往返的路程。

transcript.en: Right, well, members can borrow two books at a time from each site.
transcript.zh: 好的，会员可以在每个图书馆一次借阅两本书。

transcript.en: Only two books?
transcript.zh: 只能借两本书？

transcript.en: Only two from each site, but that's four altogether.
transcript.zh: 每个地方两本，但是一共是四本。

transcript.en: Oh I see, and how long can I hang on to them for?
transcript.zh: 我明白了，我能借走多久？

transcript.en: The borrowing period is one month, but of course books can be renewed.
transcript.zh: 借阅期是一个月，但是你可以续借。

transcript.en: You can renew any item a maximum of three times.
transcript.zh: 任何东西最多可以续借三次。

transcript.en: Do I have to come to the library to do that?
transcript.zh: 我需要来图书馆续借吗？

transcript.en: No, you can do it by telephone or email, but you can't renew overdue books this way, only before or on the due date stamped in the book.
transcript.zh: 不用，你可以通过电话或电邮续借，但是你不能续借过期的书，只能在书上标着的到期日之前和到期日续借。

transcript.en: We'll need your full name, your borrower number and the name of the site library you borrowed the items from.
transcript.zh: 我们需要知道你的全名，借方号码和你在哪所图书馆借阅的。

transcript.en: So theoretically I can borrow books for up to three months is that what you're saying?
transcript.zh: 所以理论上说，我可以最多借阅三个月，你是这个意思吧？

transcript.en: Yes, provided they're not recalled.
transcript.zh: 是的，在它们没有被召回的情况下。

transcript.en: So, what happens then?
transcript.zh: 这是什么情况？

transcript.en: Well, sometimes an item is requested by another borrower, in which case we'd send you a letter, and you'd have to return the book within seven working days.
transcript.zh: 有时，其他读者也想借阅它，这样的话我们会给你发出一封信，你得在7个工作日内将书还回来。

transcript.en: Don't forget we're closed on Sundays.
transcript.zh: 别忘了我们每周日休息。

transcript.en: OK.
transcript.zh: 好

transcript.en: I expect it'll take me a while to find what I need.
transcript.zh: 我想我需要一段时间才能找到我需要的。

transcript.en: There's such a lot here.
transcript.zh: 这太多了。

transcript.en: Yes there is, but if you need help getting started, this term we're running three study skills workshops.
transcript.zh: 是的。但是如果你需要入门帮助的话，我们在这学期有三个关于学习技巧的讲习班。

transcript.en: Oh?
transcript.zh: 哦？

transcript.en: What are they on?
transcript.zh: 都是什么

transcript.en: Er, let me see.
transcript.zh: 我看下

transcript.en: The first one's on resources yes, here it is.
transcript.zh: 第一个是……是的，在这里。

transcript.en: How to use the library's resources.
transcript.zh: 如何使用图书馆资源。

transcript.en: That includes everything, not just the print and technical resources.
transcript.zh: 其中包括所有事情，不只是打印和技术资源。

transcript.en: That sounds useful.
transcript.zh: 听起来有用。

transcript.en: Is there anything on using the Internet?
transcript.zh: 。有关于使用互联网的课程吗？

transcript.en: Er, let's see.
transcript.zh: 我看下。

transcript.en: The one on the Internet for beginners was last term.
transcript.zh: 上学期有互联网初学者的课程。

transcript.en: This term it's finding research materials online.
transcript.zh: 这学期是在网上查找素材。

transcript.en: That sounds interesting too, hm, what's the last one?
transcript.zh: 最后一个是什么？

transcript.en: It's a workshop on dissertations.
transcript.zh: 是论文讲习班。

transcript.en: What do you mean - how to write one?
transcript.zh: 什么意思？如何写论文？

transcript.en: Er, no it's more to do with academic writing conventions, you know - writing a bibliography and how to refer to sources in your text.
transcript.zh: 不是，更像是论文写作规范，像是如何写参考书目和如何在文章中引用文字之类的。

transcript.en: That sort of thing.
transcript.zh: 类似的。

transcript.en: Anyway, here's a leaflet with information about all three.
transcript.zh: 总之这是介绍三门课程的宣传单。

transcript.en: Thanks a lot.
transcript.zh: 非常感谢！

transcript.en: That'll be very useful.
transcript.zh: 那会很有用的。

transcript.en: You're welcome.
transcript.zh: 不客气。
